model: Club Tour Mk4 S+S 700c derailleur straight bar
description: Thorn Club Tour Mk4 with S+S couplers Reynolds 725 tubing. Straight bar . 700c touring bike , ideal to take you on that LEJOG trip , weekend cycle camping trips or trips to Europe. This bike would be happy to carry you on a world tour too with front and rear panniers . This bike comes with S+S couplers so the bike can be separated into two parts for ease of transport , or airline boxing , so ideal for overseas trips. Details Thorn Club Tour Mk4 with S+S couplers - Gunmetal - 550 L (SECONDS) - New build - Slight imperfection in paint finish . This bike would suit a rider of 5ft 6 (1680 mm )- 5ft 10 (1778mm) approx. Virtual top tube length 600mm, mid tube standover height 790mm . If unsure of size please contact Thorn on 01278 441505, Monday to Thursday from 8.00am to 4.00pm or sales@thorncycles.co.uk. Please note that we no longer have an open showroom.
